gates.name: Build, dependency and semantic typecheck
gates.evidence: Clean CI install, production build and semantic typecheck logs

gates.name: PostgreSQL migration install, upgrade and rollback
gates.evidence: Clean-database and upgrade execution reports; rollback rehearsal

gates.name: Playwright runtime and authenticated business journeys
gates.evidence: CI report for retail, bar, shift, inventory, procurement, refund and finance journeys

gates.name: Tenant isolation, authorization and penetration testing
gates.evidence: Tenant/role negative matrix, IDOR tests and independent penetration report

gates.name: Karnataka excise, GST and statutory tax approval
gates.evidence: Current official notifications, approved tax fixtures and signed compliance review

gates.name: Payments, refunds, chargebacks and provider certification
gates.evidence: Provider sandbox certification and end-to-end settlement reconciliation

gates.name: Accounting and inventory valuation reconciliation
gates.evidence: Approved journals, COGS/cost-layer validation, trial balance, P&L and balance-sheet tie-out

gates.name: Device attestation and offline alcohol controls
gates.evidence: Hardware-backed attestation and secure-time test evidence; offline alcohol posting must remain disabled until approved

gates.name: Integration egress, signing, retry and provider adapters
gates.evidence: SSRF-safe egress controls, signed delivery, retry/dead-letter tests and provider certification

gates.name: Backup restore, disaster recovery and resilience
gates.evidence: Observed restore drill, measured RPO/RTO, failover and load/soak reports

gates.name: Observability, alert routing and incident response
gates.evidence: Validated dashboards, actionable alerts, on-call ownership and incident rehearsal

gates.name: Business UAT, training and pilot acceptance
gates.evidence: Signed UAT, training completion, defect disposition and named pilot approval

gates.name: Production environment and secret readiness
gates.evidence: Environment-specific secret injection, TLS, access review and configuration validation

gates.name: Release rollback rehearsal and change approval
gates.evidence: Timed rollback rehearsal, database compatibility plan and approved change record

decision_rule: GO only when every gate is PASS with linked evidence and accountable owner approval. OPEN, NOT_RUN, WAIVED without documented authority, or missing evidence means NO_GO.
note: This manifest intentionally records current evidence gaps. Do not change a gate to PASS without retaining its evidence.
